data.name: Gurgamoth
data.detailed_description:
Note: Gurgamoth requires controllers to play

Gurgamoth is a flying fighting game where the level is your weapon.


Gurgamoth is the perfect mix of party chaos and competitive strategy, ideal for sitting around on the couch with a couple of friends.

Your only weapon is the level itself: a shifting battlefield with different hazards. Gurgamoth is fast, relying on quick timing, but also your ability to read your opponent. Will they dodge your attack and send you flying into a spinning saw blade? Will they spend their attacks on a power up, leaving them temporarily vulnerable? Will they anticipate your attack and stun you while you're recovering?

Get inside their minds and earn the honor of awakening Gurgamoth.

Gurgamoth features:
  • Unique levels, each with their own dangers
  • Game-changing power-ups
  • Tight flying mechanics
  • Fantastic visual design
  • Fast, party-friendly matches
  • Full controller support
  • The most fun you'll have summoning an elder god

data.short_description: Gurgamoth is a flying fighting game where the level is your weapon. Each match is lightning quick and focuses on intense flying combat and getting in your opponent's head. The controls are simple, but the mechanics and interesting levels bring out the game’s depth.
data.supported_languages: Inglês, Francês, Italiano, Alemão, Espanhol (Espanha), Português (Brasil), Russo

reviews.review:
[h1]Pros and Cons[/h1]
+="pros"; -="cons"

+ The biggest pro of this game are undoubtedly [b]graphics[/b]!
-  Although [b]characters have only an esthethical role[/b].
+ [b]Sounds are good[/b] ,too , and well combined with the gameplay
+ [b]Level design is very good although i hope something will be added in future to raise the fun-o-meter[/b]
   The concept should be "easy to play, hard to master" but 
- the game itself is [b]too frenetic[/b] and [b]controls are not very good[/b] because they are limited to 2 (Yes TWO) key buttons yet they do not offer the proper variety to the gameplay and to the control of the character 
although 
+ when played 1v1 the game is very funny and enjoyable,  without lacking competitivity! 
- There's [b]NO SUPPORT for the keyboard[/b] (Why?) So if you want to play with your friends you'll need 4 controllers. (although you may use the arrows to move and "enter" for "A" and "ú" for B) 
- The game [b]lacks some more power-ups[/b] for the characters and some [b]peculiar moves to differentiate the gameplay[/b].
+ the objects in the levels such as the spikeballs and the ice balls and the laserballs are excellent! 
- There's [b]no "story mode" or "career mode"[/b] and for a SINGLE PLAYER ONLY game this is a big problem.
- Last but not least, there's [b]NO ONLINE MULTIPLAYER[/b]... wake up guys we're in 2017 and everyone is looking for a casual game to play online with friends! Local multiplayer is certainly a limit.


[h1]Suggestions[/h1]
{} Let people configure the key bindings in the settings (and add Keyboard support)
{} Add more options to use more of the 14 buttons on the controller 
{} Add peculiar moves to characters
{} SLOW DOWN THE GAMEPLAY! Not too much, but at least of a bit that would make this game more enjoyable: in 4 players it's a complete mess! 
{} Add more modes! There's one single mode and thereby the game loses replayablity!
{} Add more Power-Ups (also "Bad power ups"  please)  to spicy the game
{} Build a campaign mode (preferrably co-op friendly) [look at "Ultratron", both for power ups and for the "campaign mode"]
{} Allow to choose whether you want to pla with 1-2 or 3 bots
{} ADD ONLINE MULTIPLAYER AND COOP 
{} ADD MODS SUPPORT! I'm curious to see what the community could develop


[h1]Final consideration[/h1]
By now, I would not suggest this game to my friends(although I would invite them to come to me and play together), and i'm looking forward to see how this will develop in the future.
Here's for example somethign a random guy made in the discussions:
[quote=AuranRage;361798516950377117]Online Multiplayer is ESSENTIAL to make this game popular and sell it more. I bought this game but I have like 30 friends willing to buy it too and none are going to because we can simply wait for that one day of the year that we come together and play it on my account. [/quote]
This is my exact situation, because there are several friends of mine that won't buy the game because it hasn't got multiplayer.
But overall the game is sufficiently enjoyable , especially when played 1vs1, so my final choice is positive, but remember that [b]I wouldn't pay more than 90 cents[/b] for this game..
